story-context.title: File Upload Component (Full Stack)
story-context.overview: Introduce file-upload end-to-end: builder + runtime + token-scoped public upload API + SubmissionAttachment persistence + bind on submit + company download. Align types with existing DefinitionJSON / form_definition.py patterns from 6.2.1.

constraints.item: Do NOT run Alembic upgrade/downgrade/revision in agent shell; prepare migration file(s) and give Anthony exact commands.
Never commit secrets; storage path from env/config only.
Attach uploaded files to FormSubmission only after successful submission; never expose raw storage paths to browser.
Use opaque UUID (or similar) as client-facing attachment id; validate ownership on submit.

file.purpose: Add FILE_UPLOAD = 'file-upload' to ComponentType enum; extend ComponentProps if needed for documented props.
Submission handler: accept attachment references in answers; orchestrate link to FormSubmissionID.
Document/validate answer shapes for file-upload (e.g. array of attachment ids or structured object).
Mount new upload route module if split from router for clarity.
Add 'file-upload' to ComponentType; file-upload props (accept, max size, multiple, maxFiles).
Register file-upload with structure, preview, runtime.
Treat file-upload as input with label+input+validation pattern.
Render file input; call upload API; merge ids into submit payload.
Mark file-upload as implemented; constraints for AI.
SQLAlchemy model SubmissionAttachment (name aligned with migration).
Optional: multipart upload + download handlers if cleaner than monolithic router.
Example name—use next revision after current Alembic head.
Integration-style tests: validate definition, upload mock, submit bind, auth download.

reference-patterns.pattern: See existing POST submissions in public_form_router.py; mirror token resolution, link type, idempotency. answers_by_component_id is JSON-serializable dict—keep attachment refs as strings or small objects agreed in schema.
See story-context-6.2.1.xml for registry + structureDefaults + PropertiesPanel patterns (url/rating).
Follow 035_form_submission_table.py style: MSSQL types, dbo schema, explicit FKs and indexes.

security-checklist.item: Validate token → FormPublicLink → FormID/Version/Correct status for upload and submit.
Reject attachment ids that belong to another FormPublicLink or orphaned row not tied to client context.
Download endpoint: reuse same authorization as lead/submission export APIs.
